skills: Compare the ways Claude Code can take on multiple tasks at once: subagents, agent view, agent teams, dynamic workflows, and projects. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agents
Create and use specialized AI subagents in Claude Code for task-specific workflows and improved context management. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
Manage multiple agents with agent view
Dispatch and manage many Claude Code sessions from one screen. Agent view shows what every session is doing and which ones need your input. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view
Orchestrate teams of Claude Code sessions
Coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together as a team, with shared tasks, inter-agent messaging, and centralized management. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams
Message your other Claude Code sessions
Let Claude list and message your other Claude Code sessions on this machine, and reach your sessions on other machines or in the cloud. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cross-session-messaging
Orchestrate subagents at scale with dynamic workflows

Dynamic workflows orchestrate many subagents from a script Claude writes and you can rerun. Use them for codebase audits, large migrations, and cross-checked research. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows

Isolate parallel Claude Code sessions in separate git worktrees so changes don't collide. Covers the `--worktree` flag, subagent isolation, `.worktreeinclude`, cleanup, and non-git VCS hooks. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/worktrees
Add an MCP server to Claude Code, verify the connection, and find the configuration on disk. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp-quickstart
Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP
Learn how to connect Claude Code to your tools with the Model Context Protocol. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp
Create, manage, and share skills to extend Claude's capabilities in Claude Code. Includes custom commands and bundled skills. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills

Artifacts turn Claude Code's work into live, interactive pages on claude.ai that you can keep private, share with your organization, or publish to a public link. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/artifacts

Run shell commands automatically when Claude Code edits files, finishes tasks, or needs input. Format code, send notifications, validate commands, and enforce project rules. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide
Push events into a running session with channels

Use channels to push messages, alerts, and webhooks into your Claude Code session from an MCP server. Forward CI results, chat messages, and monitoring events so Claude can react while you're away. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/channels
Use /loop and the cron scheduling tools to run prompts repeatedly, poll for status, or set one-time reminders within a Claude Code session. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/scheduled-tasks
Keep Claude working toward a goal
Set a completion condition with /goal and Claude keeps working until it's met, a model judges it impossible, or an error you have to fix clears the goal. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/goal
Use the Agent SDK to run Claude Code programmatically from the CLI, Python, or TypeScript. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless

Open a Claude Code terminal session from a URL. Embed `claude-cli://` links in runbooks, alerts, and dashboards so a click opens Claude Code in the right repo with the right prompt. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/deep-links
Set up Claude Code in a monorepo or large codebase

Configure Claude Code for monorepos and large single-tree codebases with nested CLAUDE.md files, sparse worktrees, code intelligence, and per-package skills so Claude stays focused on the code you're working in. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/large-codebases
Fix command not found, PATH, permission, network, and authentication errors when installing or signing in to Claude Code. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install
Fix high CPU or memory usage, hangs, auto-compact thrashing, and search problems in Claude Code, and find the right page for other issues. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshooting

Diagnose why CLAUDE.md, settings, hooks, MCP servers, or skills aren't taking effect. Use /context, /doctor, /hooks, and /mcp to see what actually loaded. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/debug-your-config
Look up Claude Code runtime error messages with what each one means and how to fix it. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/errors
